subject: Roadshow compression — request to swap live demo for a condensed recorded slot
messages:
From: Ellie Tanaka <ellie.tanaka@auralabs.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai
Cc: jared.mills@auralabs.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Roadshow week — demo window compressed, can we swap to recorded condensed session?

Hi Logan,

Quick heads up — our execs just compressed the West Coast roadshow schedule and the onsite slot we booked with Redwood (Nov 18, 11:00–12:00) has been moved earlier in the day to a travel briefing. That leaves our team with a 30-minute window on the morning of Nov 18 only.

We still want the demo but need it to be either:
- a 25–30 minute condensed recording we can watch asynchronously before the meeting, plus a 15-minute live Q&A with the final decision-makers later that afternoon (if possible), or
- a 30-minute live condensed demo in that tight morning window (not ideal for multiple participants traveling).

Can Redwood produce a recorded condensed demo tailored to our integration questions (auth, VPC, and batch inference) by Nov 17 EOD? If so, please send a short intake checklist and a recording link we can distribute.

Attaching the updated roadshow itinerary. Jared is helping coordinate on our side.

Thanks —
Ellie
Director, Platform Partnerships
Aura Labs

Attachment: roadshow-itinerary.ics (calendar stub)
From: logan.wright@redwood.ai <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Tanaka <ellie.tanaka@auralabs.com>
Cc: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Roadshow week — demo window compressed, can we swap to recorded condensed session?

Thanks for the update, Ellie — appreciate the heads up and totally understand the constraint. We can absolutely support a condensed recorded demo plus a short live Q&A. Proposed plan: 

1) We produce a 20–25 minute recorded demo focused on the items you listed (auth, VPC topology, batch inference patterns). We’ll include a 3-slide architecture summary for your execs.
2) Recording delivered by Nov 17 EOD (video link + one-page tl;dr).
3) Live 15-minute Q&A on Nov 18 at 4:00 PM PT (we can also do 3:30 PM if that helps) — note that Soojin will join for technical questions.

Soojin and Marissa — can you confirm recording availability and whether the condensed guide can include a short segment on Dedicated vs Private deployment economics? Also flag any blockers if we need customer-specific redaction.

Ellie — if that plan works I’ll send a calendar invite for the Q&A and a short intake form (three quick multiple-choice items) so the recording addresses your decision-makers’ top questions.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: soojin.lee@redwood.ai <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, Ellie Tanaka <ellie.tanaka@auralabs.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Roadshow week — demo window compressed, can we swap to recorded condensed session?

Looping in technical details — happy to own the recording. A few operational notes before we commit to Nov 17 EOD: 

- We can produce a 22-minute walk-through + 3-slide arc. We need the following by EOD Nov 11 to tailor the recording:
  * Confirmation of which auth flow matters most (API key / mTLS / KMS-integrated tokens).
  * A brief sample prompt pattern or inference profile (short prompt with expected token lengths) so we show realistic latency/cost numbers.
  * Any redaction requirements for example data.

- I’ll record on Nov 16 and run a quick internal edit pass on Nov 17 morning. Output will be MP4 + Loom-style trimmed highlights + one-page tl;dr PDF (demo-compact-guide.pdf).

- For the live Q&A (15 min), recommend we use Nov 18 16:00 PT — I can stay for 20 minutes in case the execs have follow-ups. If you think they’ll push for 30 min, we should block 45 min just in case.

Marissa — could you prepare the tl;dr deck and upload slides to the Drive link Logan referenced? I’ll include a brief section on Dedicated vs Private economics that compares token-level cost and latency trade-offs.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ellie Tanaka <ellie.tanaka@auralabs.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai
Cc: jared.mills@auralabs.com, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Roadshow week — demo window compressed, can we swap to recorded condensed session?

Perfect — that timeline works for us. We’ll: 

- Confirm auth flow: mTLS for production, API keys for initial PoC (sending a short note by EOD Nov 11).
- Send a representative prompt and token estimate (one short example) by EOD Nov 11.
- Plan for Nov 18 16:00 PT live Q&A (please send the invite).

Please include an MP4 + Loom link and the one-pager when ready. If you can also include speaker notes for the tl;dr slides that call out trade-offs for dedicated vs private deployments, that will help our execs decide immediately.

Thanks for being flexible — we want to keep momentum despite the roadshow shuffle.

Ellie

Attachment: demo-compact-guide.pdf (to be provided by Redwood)
